packageRules.description: The shipped package is PHP-only; every Composer dependency lives in build/ and is used purely to regenerate the excludes list, which CI validates. Automerge minor & patch (both require and require-dev in build/) once CI is green.
GitHub Actions: group into one PR, pin to commit SHAs, and automerge minor/patch/digest.
Major bumps (e.g. a new php-scoper / nikic/php-parser line) can change scoping output — never automerge, and flag them.
